g.text: Arduino source: D9 / OC1A, 250 Hz, 50%, 5 V.

g.desc: Arduino source: D9 / OC1A, 250 Hz, 50%, 5 V.

g.text: 4 supervisor WDT through board resistor / PL5 pin221; 5 nRES pin58; 6 GND.

g.desc: 4 supervisor WDT through board resistor / PL5 pin221; 5 nRES pin58; 6 GND.

g.text: U1 OE is tied LOW. J5 powers only the regulated 5 V buffer.

g.desc: U1 OE is tied LOW. J5 powers only the regulated 5 V buffer.

g.text: J1: 1 SCI1_TX / PC0 pin165; 2 SCI1_RX / PC1 pin166; 3 MD1 pin55;

g.desc: J1: 1 SCI1_TX / PC0 pin165; 2 SCI1_RX / PC1 pin166; 3 MD1 pin55;

g.text: WDT SOURCE - FIT JP1 OR JP2, NEVER BOTH

g.desc: WDT SOURCE - FIT JP1 OR JP2, NEVER BOTH

g.text: TXD -> SCI1_RX; RXD -> SCI1_TX. Adapter VCC is NC.

g.desc: TXD -> SCI1_RX; RXD -> SCI1_TX. Adapter VCC is NC.

g.text: Do not use legacy type A power testpoints on JK00D / JK08A.

g.desc: Do not use legacy type A power testpoints on JK00D / JK08A.

g.text: J6 powers the ECU only through the verified bench harness.

g.desc: J6 powers the ECU only through the verified bench harness.

g.text: STM32 source: timer 240-250 Hz, 50%; U1 converts 3.3 V to 5 V.

g.desc: STM32 source: timer 240-250 Hz, 50%; U1 converts 3.3 V to 5 V.

g.text: R1 and R2 are provisional service resistors; verify the board before fitting.

g.desc: R1 and R2 are provisional service resistors; verify the board before fitting.

g.text: Inquiry must be non-destructive. Do not send 0x40.

g.desc: Inquiry must be non-destructive. Do not send 0x40.

g.text: SEQUENCE: MD1 LOW + nRES LOW -> WDT ON -> ECU POWER ON -> release nRES -> SCI1 inquiry.

g.desc: SEQUENCE: MD1 LOW + nRES LOW -> WDT ON -> ECU POWER ON -> release nRES -> SCI1 inquiry.

g.text: Initial WDT hypothesis: 240-250 Hz, 50%, 0-5 V. R5=10R is a reference value.

g.desc: Initial WDT hypothesis: 240-250 Hz, 50%, 0-5 V. R5=10R is a reference value.

g.text: SH7058S NATIVE BOOT RECOVERY HARNESS - JK00D / JK08A

g.desc: SH7058S NATIVE BOOT RECOVERY HARNESS - JK00D / JK08A

g.text: WARNING: J1 is logical only. Verify every PCB testpoint by continuity to MCU pins. Never probe MCU pins directly.

g.desc: WARNING: J1 is logical only. Verify every PCB testpoint by continuity to MCU pins. Never probe MCU pins directly.

g.text: Common GND: ECU harness, USB-UART, WDT source, 5 V buffer, and oscilloscope.

g.desc: Common GND: ECU harness, USB-UART, WDT source, 5 V buffer, and oscilloscope.

g.text: J7: CH1 WDT_IN; CH2 nRES; pin 3 GND.

g.desc: J7: CH1 WDT_IN; CH2 nRES; pin 3 GND.
